data.title: 守岸人 · 灯塔下的潮汐泳装
data.description: 【黑海岸浅湾·傍晚】守岸人穿着蓝白泳装坐在浅湾岩石上，白色长发与轻纱披肩被海风吹开；她把捡到的发光水母形贝壳放在掌心，抬头看向镜头，像第一次真正享受海水的温度。
data.location: shallow cove beneath the Black Shores lighthouse
data.action: 浅湾岩石上捧发光水母形贝壳，第一次真正享受海水温度
data.lighting: soft evening glow on translucent water
data.promptProse: The Shorekeeper from Wuthering Waves wears a blue-and-white coastal swimsuit with a translucent shoulder wrap, shell bracelet and bare feet. She sits on a smooth rock in the shallow cove, opening her palm to a shell shaped like a glowing jellyfish. The sea moves around her bare feet while the shoulder wrap lifts in the breeze, and she looks toward the viewer with quiet wonder at the water’s warmth. soft evening glow on translucent water.
